focus.title: 欧盟拟对中国电动汽车加征临时反补贴关税，中企应提前布局供应链合规
focus.summary: 欧盟委员会于7月16日公布了对中国电动汽车反补贴调查的初步裁定，拟对多家中国车企加征17%至36%不等的临时关税。该措施预计将在8月初正式实施，受影响企业需在30天内提交抗辩材料。建议相关企业立即梳理供应链原产地证明、补贴受益情况，并评估通过海外建厂或调整出口路径降低关税影响。
focus.title_en: EU Plans Provisional Anti-Subsidy Tariffs on Chinese EVs; Chinese Companies Should Prepare Supply Chain Compliance
focus.summary_en: On July 16, the European Commission published its preliminary findings in the anti-subsidy investigation into Chinese electric vehicles, proposing provisional tariffs ranging from 17% to 36% on several Chinese automakers. The measures are expected to take effect in early August, with affected companies having 30 days to submit rebuttals. Affected enterprises should promptly review supply chain origin documentation and subsidy benefits, and evaluate options such as overseas manufacturing or adjusting export routes to mitigate tariff impacts.

case.title: 新加坡国际仲裁中心裁定：中国公司与东南亚合资方争议中，保密协议违约方需赔偿230万美元
case.summary: 2026年6月，SIAC就一起中国科技企业与马来西亚合资方的技术许可纠纷作出裁决。因中方未按约定对联合研发的算法源代码采取保密措施，导致技术泄露至第三方，仲裁庭认定中方违反保密条款，裁定赔偿230万美元及承担仲裁费用。该案提示中企在跨境技术合作中须建立严格的保密制度，并明确违约后果。
case.source: 来源：新加坡国际仲裁中心（SIAC） · 2026年6月
case.title_en: SIAC Rules Chinese Company Breached Confidentiality in Joint Venture, Ordered to Pay USD 2.3 Million
case.summary_en: In June 2026, the Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) ruled on a technology licensing dispute between a Chinese tech firm and its Malaysian joint venture partner. The tribunal found that the Chinese party failed to implement adequate confidentiality measures for jointly developed algorithm source code, leading to leakage to a third party. It ordered compensation of USD 2.3 million and costs. This case highlights the need for Chinese enterprises to establish strict confidentiality protocols in cross-border tech collaborations and clearly define breach consequences.
case.source_en: Source: Singapore International Arbitration Centre (SIAC) · June 2026

policy.title: 粤港澳大湾区跨境纠纷解决新规：深圳前海法院试点涉外商事案件在线调解与认证
policy.summary: 广东省高级人民法院于7月15日发布《关于深化粤港澳大湾区跨境商事纠纷多元化解机制的指导意见》，自8月1日起在前海合作区法院试点。新规允许当事人通过在线平台申请调解，并认可经港澳公证机构认证的电子证据。此举将大幅降低跨境诉讼成本，尤其适合涉港澳合同纠纷与知识产权案件。
policy.source: 来源：广东省高级人民法院 · 2026.07.15
policy.title_en: New Rules for Cross-Border Dispute Resolution in GBA: Qianhai Court Pilots Online Mediation and E-Evidence Certification
policy.summary_en: On July 15, the Guangdong High People's Court issued the Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Diversified Dispute Resolution Mechanism for Cross-Border Commercial Disputes in the Guangdong-Hong Kong-Macao Greater Bay Area, to be piloted at Qianhai Cooperation Zone Court from August 1. The new rules allow parties to apply for mediation via online platforms and recognize electronic evidence certified by Hong Kong or Macao notaries. This will significantly reduce cross-border litigation costs, particularly for contract and IP disputes involving Hong Kong and Macao.

analysis.title: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国对华半导体出口管制再升级，中国企业应建立“合规缓冲带”
analysis.summary: 秦林蒿律师研判：美国商务部工业安全局（BIS）拟于7月底更新对华半导体设备出口管制，将14nm以下制程设备纳入“推定拒绝”清单。建议中国半导体企业：1）立即梳理现有美系设备采购合同中的“管制触发条款”；2）对在途订单申请“临时通用许可”；3）加快国产替代验证，同时通过第三国转口贸易需谨慎评估“最终用户”风险。英文版：Attorney Qin's view: The BIS plans to expand export controls on semiconductor equipment to China, adding sub-14nm tools to a 'presumption of denial' list. Chinese semiconductor firms should: 1) review existing US-equipment contracts for 'control trigger clauses'; 2) apply for temporary general licenses for in-transit orders; 3) accelerate domestic substitution validation, while cautiously assessing 'end-user' risks for third-country transshipment.
analysis.title_en: Attorney Qin's View: US Semiconductor Export Controls Tighten; Chinese Firms Should Build 'Compliance Buffers'
analysis.summary_en: Attorney Qin's view: The BIS plans to expand export controls on semiconductor equipment to China, adding sub-14nm tools to a 'presumption of denial' list. Chinese semiconductor firms should: 1) review existing US-equipment contracts for 'control trigger clauses'; 2) apply for temporary general licenses for in-transit orders; 3) accelerate domestic substitution validation, while cautiously assessing 'end-user' risks for third-country transshipment.
